description: Pakistan - Electricity Transmission Network is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries", published or maintained by World Bank Group. The transmission network map is obtained from the OpenStreetMap (OSM) database version 06.Feb.2017. The level of completeness varies across different areas due to poor satellite/aerial imagery and/or resolution in some areas, and due to a lack of OSM editors to help improve the data. Coverage: Pakistan. It has 3 files in JSON, PDF. The portal files it under Extractive industries. The portal gives 2025 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
